title: Relay Gardens
description: Instrument-stream run against a local creator preview of the workspace copy, per the games/smoke.json pattern: `npx @dcl/sdk-commands start --no-browser --port 8021` in the scene dir, `decentra-bevy --server http://127.0.0.1:8021 --mcp --mcp-port 8131`. The realm below is that url because it is what this explorer reports as its realm (measured 2026-08-22, current bevy build; the LocalPreview name smoke.json documents is what an older build reported) - the wrong-world gate then refuses any client that is not in this exact preview, which is the honest outcome. The port is pinned per scene by scripts/foundry-bench-scenes.sh; serve elsewhere and the run refuses by design. The scene self-plays: src/driver.ts deals bot hands through alternating trio/solo sessions on the live board, so the checks below measure that every doc-§9 instrument actually streams to the scene log, not that a human played. Pacing (src/const.ts): 1.5 s per phase, 5 s settle pause; a trio session fills the 7x7 plot in well under the 90 s wait, and the next session (solo) starts inside it, so both modes' session lines land in the ring.

steps.label: one full trio session settles and the solo session starts; the log ring is drained throughout
bloom pattern after the first settle

checks.why: a scene that throws on load looks fine in a screenshot and is broken
an async failure the scene swallowed still leaves state half-applied
every design number the doc commits to is emitted once at boot (doc §9)
a trio session ran - doc §9 reads Coordination Lift from trio sessions
a solo session ran - doc §9 reads Solo Stall against it on the same build
public hands (interview #3): one line per player per round
Plant Phase placements are on the record, one line per tile
doc §9 'Round-Bloom-Count' - the Solo Stall instrument streams per round
doc §9 'Settle-Point-Triggered' - the engine detected a session end
doc §9 'Final-Coverage-Percent' - the session score, with the Appendix A bloom_to_tile ratio
